item.title: 📍 Peak intensity: CSTO active phase of Unbreakable Brotherhood 2026 and Barrier 2026 exercises
item.description: Peak intensity: CSTO active phase of Unbreakable Brotherhood 2026 and Barrier 2026 exercises 📍 The final stages of the command post exercise with the Unbreakable Brotherhood 2026 CSTO Peacekeeping Forces and the Barrier 2026 special exercise with joint formation of NBC protection troops and medical support of the CSTO were held at the Losvido and Starodorozhskiy training grounds in the Republic of Belarus. ▫️ Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation General of the Army Yunus-Bek Yevkurov and Chief of the CSTO Joint Staff Colonel General Andrei Serdyukov took part in the drill. ▫️ Units conducted a peacekeeping operation during the manoeuvres on the territory of the CSTO member State. The servicemen supported the ceasefire and ensured the terms of the truce. Formations of the CSTO Collective Forces of the Republic of Belarus, the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, the Russian Federation, and the Republic of Tajikistan took part in the exercises. More than 1,500 servicemen and more than 300 units of weapons, military and support hardware were deployed including about 80 different types of UAVs. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federatio n continued to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres
item.description: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federatio n continued to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres employed in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine as well as vessels that delivered military cargo to Ukraine. ▫️ As a result of the strike in Rovno, the Equator logistics centre used to store and distribute cargo in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine was hit. ▫️ Moreover, a dry cargo ship was hit at sea. It was carrying military and dual-use cargo to the port of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 Malaysia is over stern: Pacific Fleet's ship detachment completes visit to Butterworth
item.description: 📍 Malaysia is over stern: Pacific Fleet's ship detachment completes visit to Butterworth A ship detachment of the Pacific Fleet comprising the frigate Marshal Shaposhnikov, the large anti-submarine ship Admiral Tributs, and the tanker Pechenga have completed a business call at the Malaysian port of Butterworth. 🤝 The command of the detachment met with representatives of the Malaysian Navy and the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Russia in Malaysia Nail Latypov. ▫️ On the island of Jerejak, Russian sailors paid tribute to the crew of the cruiser Zhemchug, laying flowers and holding a memorial service. They also took part in cultural events and sporting competitions. The Pacific Fleet ship detachment left Vladivostok on 10 September to perform tasks in the Pacific Rim. Previously , the crews made a business call at the port of the city of Jakarta of the Republic of Indonesia. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ From 10 to 16 October, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out massive and seven group strikes
item.description: ❗️ From 10 to 16 October, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out massive and seven group strikes . item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30084

❗️
From 10 to 16 October, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out massive and seven group strikes
. As a result, they hit enterprises of the Ukrainian defence industry, logistics and telecommunication centres, transport infrastructure facilities used for the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, production and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles, ammunition and military hardware depots as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries.
💥
Moreover,
a number of infrastructure facilities of Ukrainian ports
, which received, stored, and distributed military cargo, have been disabled.
▪️
Over the week, 15 dry cargo ships involved in supplying Western weapons, military hardware, fuel, and materiel to the Armed Forces of Ukraine were neutralised.
⏩
Units of the Sever Group of Forces continued to tighten the encirclement
around enemy's formations in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone.
🚩
Last week, as a result of active and decisive actions, Russian troops took under control
Lukashovo, Lobanovka, Reznikovo, Kupino, Nefedovka
, and
Chernoye
. Yesterday,
Varvarovka
and
Nikolayevka
(Kharkov region) were taken under controlled. All the enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement were thwarted.
💥
In Kharkov and Sumy regions
, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of six mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, four territorial defence brigades, and one national guard brigade.
▪️
Over the past week, in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces, the enemy has lost more than 1,675 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 82 motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, and eight electronic warfare stations.
↗️
During the week, the Zapad Group of Forces have taken more advantageous lines
and positions. Russian units inflicted losses on formations of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades.
▪️
The AFU losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,550 troops, 18 armoured fighting vehicles, 94 motor vehicles, 12 field artillery guns, and 11 electronic warfare stations.
↗️
Last week, the Yuzhnaya Group's units improved the situation along the front line
. Russian units inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, a mountain assault brigade, an airmobile brigade, an unmanned systems brigade, a marine brigade, and territorial defence brigade.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 1,155 troops, nine armoured fighting vehicles, 198 motor vehicles, 13 field artillery guns, and two electronic warfare stations in the area of responsibility of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces.
👉
